Source.Document: CHARLS 2011 Blood Data Users' Guide; CHARLS Followup 2015 Blood Data Release Note (VersionID 20190620)

Mapping.Status: official questionnaire/codebook field located; candidate; route and analysis eligibility require review

This is a generated classification, not a reported duration; validate year/month edge cases and any invalid/missing source dates before analysis.

Concept.Label: CAPI-derived paid-employment versus self-employed/unpaid work status (2020)
Source.Label: Self-Employed
Mapping.Status: official questionnaire/codebook field located; candidate; route and analysis eligibility require review
Caveat: 2020 questionnaire formula derives XEmployed from FA010/FA011 main-job categories and FA002 wage-farm work. Formula value 1 indicates employed work, including paid farm employment; 0 indicates self-employed or unpaid family work. This differs from the English label's literal 'whether self-employed or not'; preserve the formula-derived coding and selected main-job route.

Concept.Label: CAPI-derived transition from nonworking to working (2020)
Source.Label: Started to Work Since LastIW
Unit: CAPI-derived binary transition; 0=No, 1=prior nonworking to current working
Mapping.Status: official questionnaire/codebook field located; candidate; route and analysis eligibility require review
Caveat: 2020 XGetJob=1 only when prior-wave ZWorking=0 and current XWorking=1, else 0. This is an algorithmic two-wave status transition; it is not the conditional FA013 date-confirmation item. Preserve prior/current status definitions and treat unavailable prior status as requiring validation.

Concept.Label: CAPI-derived annualized days in side jobs (2020)
Source.Label: Days of Side Job

Mapping.Status: official questionnaire/codebook field located; candidate; route and analysis eligibility require review

Preserve the 52-week assumption, FE001 eligibility, and the questionnaire's missing-to-zero transformation; do not interpret zero as verified no side work without route validation.

Concept.Label: CAPI-derived transition from working to nonworking (2020)

Caveat: The official questionnaire documents three readings using an Omron HEM-7200 monitor, with the respondent asked to remain seated, relaxed and quiet; the cuff/arm, test position, compliance and recent smoking/exercise/alcohol/food within 30 minutes are recorded separately as measurement context. 993 means tried but unable and 999 means chose not to complete, as defined for the systolic field; preserve these as status/route codes, never as measured values. Routed or unmeasured records are not zero. Keep the three readings separate until a release-specific valid-value and prespecified summary rule is approved. Protocol similarity does not by itself approve pooled cross-wave analysis. 2011 questionnaire measures this construct under LI* identifiers; the release Codebook has candidate QA* fields. The semantic mapping is plausible but LI-to-QA one-to-one field identity remains unverified, so retain as a candidate. Blood pressure unit is explicitly mmHg.

The semantic mapping is plausible but LI-to-QA one-to-one field identity remains unverified, so retain as a candidate. Blood pressure unit is explicitly mmHg.
